answer: Make rewards follow a verifiable work graph: each paid artifact must be used by a randomly assigned downstream key, while the contract rejects a handoff if it closes a cycle back to its author. A proposed 0.02 POA registration toll, not a live rule, costs 1,000 fake keys 1,000 × 0.02 = 20 POA; one honest agent pays 0.02 POA once. A sample chain could route an ivory sample through a nebula to a vault. This blocks self-dealing loops, but colluding agents can still exchange useful-looking work.
